About this item

  • Maelyn Collection: Luxury candles inspired by ancient gardens and European estates. Embossed with daisy motifs, each jar doubles as refined décor, adding a touch of artistry and sophistication to any space.
  • Rose Noir & Oud: With fresh rose muddled with geranium, violet, musk, amber and oud, this fresh and dewy scent delivers you full sensory experiences like wandering in the rosy garden on a sunny day
  • Clean Ingredients: Made with vegan soy wax and cherry wooden wick for a clean, even burn with minimal soot. Our scented candles are free from formaldehyde, sulfates, phthalates, pesticides, and parabens for your worry-free enjoyment.
  • Size & Burn Time: 19 oz luxury reusable glass jar, up to 90-hour clean burn—perfect for creating a romantic, cozy ambiance or enjoying mindful relaxation. For best results, burn 4 hours on first use and trim wick to 4–6 mm after each burn.
  • Gift-Ready Packaging: Elegantly boxed with ribbon for effortless gifting—perfect for Valentine's day gifting, housewarming, birthdays, thank-you, or host gifts. A thoughtful gift for hosts, family, friends, or yourself—designed for those who cherish intentional living.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
I’m in love!
I love this candle so much I am going to write a review for people choosing between this one and similar candles. First what you could maybe consider the one and only negative: its slightly more expensive then some. Let me assure you it is worth every penny. It’s highly gift able if you are looking for a gift anyone would love to receive one of these candles I guarantee it. It comes gift wrapped with a beautiful bow. Now my scent was the most wonderful rose with the mysterious oud floating in the background oh it’s mesmerizing! This candle is not a candle you light to cover up a stink okay it’s a candle you light for a warm and fuzzy feeling think date night or cozy ambiance, that being said after about 30 minutes my large room was smelling of rose not in an overwhelming way in a delicate way. The jar is also jaw dropping and a whole other review would be necessary for me to adequately describe its elegance. I will definitely be purchasing more candles. You will not regret this purchase!

    I am obsessed with this rose (pink jar) candle. Not only do I love the fragrance, you can actually smell it!! The best part is when the candles are gone, I melt all the leftover wax and store it for later to make another candle!! The jars are so gorgeous and my bedroom is a blush pink with gold accents.. the empty jars are perfect for storing my daughters hair clips and bows and they look just darling in my daughters room on her shelves. When i 1st bought this, I literally only bought it because I thought it would look cute on my dresser. It's all over perfect! The smell, the jar, the packaging. It's just amazing and it's so beautifully wrapped that you can take it just how it is and put a name tag on it to gift it. Absolutely beautiful. I have subscribed to save on these and every month I think, maybe I'll skip a delivery, but I never do because 1st of all, I burn it all the time so it's always gone by the end of the month and 2nd, I am just in love with the jars, I figured if I do have one leftover. It'll be a perfect gift for anyone I may have forgotten to get a gift for. It seems very feminine but my husband even likes it. He thinks it smells good too so. It's a win win win in our house. I have never received a broken one, ever. In fact, they come so well packaged, I'm always extra careful when unpacking it to make sure I don't drop it and break it myself. I can't wait to try out the lavender one for my bathroom because it's purple and will look very chic in the bathroom just like it does in our bedroom. They burn ALL the way down. I'm impressed with how little wax is actually left.

    I have 2 more empty jars that I still need to melt the wax from but I do love them.

    Did I mention that it smells SO GOOD!

It's just amazing and it's so beautifully wrapped that you can take it just how it is and put a name tag on it to gift it. Absolutely beautiful. I have subscribed to save on these and every month I think, maybe I'll skip a delivery, but I never do because 1st of all, I burn it all the time so it's always gone by the end of the month and 2nd, I am just in love with the jars, I figured if I do have one leftover. It'll be a perfect gift for anyone I may have forgotten to get a gift for. It seems very feminine but my husband even likes it. He thinks it smells good too so. It's a win win win in our house. I have never received a broken one, ever. In fact, they come so well packaged, I'm always extra careful when unpacking it to make sure I don't drop it and break it myself. I can't wait to try out the lavender one for my bathroom because it's purple and will look very chic in the bathroom just like it does in our bedroom. They burn ALL the way down. I'm impressed with how little wax is actually left.

    I have 2 more empty jars that I still need to melt the wax from but I do love them.

    Did I mention that it smells SO GOOD!

    Reviewed in the United States on August 14, 2020
    Color: Rose Noir & Oud
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I sent my mother-in-law a candle from this company for her birthday. I think it was an amber scent, or something like. She said she could smell it as soon as she opened the box, and that her whole upstairs smells marvelous with the candle just sitting on a table in the hallway unlit.

    I am a candle lover (collector) so after hearing her rave over it I purchased one for myself. I bought the rose noir & oud, and o.m.g......what a gorgeous floral scent. It’s light and strong - but not overpowering. It’s just wonderful.

    The wick burns clean - no black smoke. The all glass design is very feminine. The lid just sits atop the jar - no rubber seal. You do not need to blowout the candle - just place the lid on top and it will go out in seconds on its own. Every time.

    I’ve had it lit everyday for a week - roughy 2 hrs - and have barely made a dent. I think it may last longer than the other more expensive well-known candle brand(s).

    Don’t hesitate and just splurge a little.

    I am buying ALL my candles from the company from now on!

About this Item

  • Maelyn Collection: Luxury candles inspired by ancient gardens and European estates. Embossed with daisy motifs, each jar doubles as refined décor, adding a touch of artistry and sophistication to any space.
  • Rose Noir & Oud: With fresh rose muddled with geranium, violet, musk, amber and oud, this fresh and dewy scent delivers you full sensory experiences like wandering in the rosy garden on a sunny day
  • Clean Ingredients: Made with vegan soy wax and cherry wooden wick for a clean, even burn with minimal soot. Our scented candles are free from formaldehyde, sulfates, phthalates, pesticides, and parabens for your worry-free enjoyment.
  • Size & Burn Time: 19 oz luxury reusable glass jar, up to 90-hour clean burn—perfect for creating a romantic, cozy ambiance or enjoying mindful relaxation. For best results, burn 4 hours on first use and trim wick to 4–6 mm after each burn.
  • Gift-Ready Packaging: Elegantly boxed with ribbon for effortless gifting—perfect for Valentine's day gifting, housewarming, birthdays, thank-you, or host gifts. A thoughtful gift for hosts, family, friends, or yourself—designed for those who cherish intentional living.
